correctness.rationale: The exact all-size counting formulas and growth conclusions are correct. The two-time majority rule enforces y=F(x) and x=F(y); a closed walk counted in the trace has a specified starting position, as required for labelled vertices, and each x determines exactly one y. True recurrence is limited to periods one and two: with ±1 spins and symmetric adjacency A, the next state is the unique maximizer of zᵀAx over z, so the adjacent-time bilinear form increases strictly unless the next state equals the previous one. Mixed columns in a fixed prism force the same mixed column on both neighbors, giving two such patterns. Pure columns produce cyclic binary words without isolated bits. Independent exact replay /workspace/reproductions/5.py constructs the complete graph with tuple predicates, computes SCCs by mutual reachability and characteristic polynomials by Newton identities on integer traces, and confirms all relevant polynomials and 400 transitions. There is a non-load-bearing error at RESULT.md line 34: there are 220 loopless singleton components, not 222 (the six live blocks contain 36 vertices; 222 counts both looped singletons too). They contribute zero at any positive power. The live spectra give L_(2n)+2+2cos(2nπ/3) for odd n and L_(2n)+(4+4c)L_n+8+10c for even n, where c=cos(nπ/3). The two cases evaluate to the displayed residue laws. This confirms the Finding independently of the sentence miscount and without relying on the finite n=3,…,10 table.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The untwisted seam leaves all of those pure-column words unchanged and allows exactly two constant mixed-column configurations, so Q_n=R_n+2. On the bipartite double cover (v,s), edges switch time sheet s; a fixed assignment to both sheets is exactly a pair x,y with F(x)=y and F(y)=x, hence counts Fix(F²). For even n, the cover of C_n square K₂ splits into two prisms by i+r+s mod 2 and gives P_n=Q_n². For odd n, send (i,r,s) to (j,r), where j=i mod n and j=r+s mod 2; this gives the prism of circumference 2n, since ring edges change j by one and rungs preserve j. Thus P_n=Q_(2n) in that case. Substituting the earlier exact cyclic-word count proves both frozen formulas immediately, and the exponential asymptotics are automatic. This is a concrete implication, not a claim that the earlier crossed-seam statement itself counts prism orbits.
